migration-accelerator/capabilities/platforms/hubspot.yaml — consent.model, "(contact × subscription type) → status + legal basis, plus an account-level suppression layer", object_catalog.consent_and_identity.subscription_types ("Ceiling commonly stated as 1,000 per account", unverified, which is why the top band says "dozens" rather than naming a limit) and preference_pages, "per-brand-domain and per-language", which is the artefact that multiplies at option 3. The base wording offered "standard publication or subscription lists" — a Marketing Cloud construct — as its bottom option, so a HubSpot respondent's most likely honest answer was not on the scale. COUNTS AND PLACES ONLY. Whether that state has provenance and survives the mapping onto publication lists is slot 7, and preference_page_rebuild is priced there rather than here: this dimension sizes the permission model, that slot judges whether it moves intact.
